subs: Beds on its Medicare cost report. A licensed bed count usually runs higher.
Every intensive and special care unit counts: adult, cardiac, surgical, burn, neonatal and pediatric.
Each inpatient stay that ended counts once, whoever paid for it.
All inpatient days divided by discharges. Answer in days, like 4.5.
Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.
Medicare Advantage plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Medicaid managed care plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payroll only: not clinics, not contract staff.
From AHRQ's 2023 list of who owns which hospital, matched to Medicare's hospital list.
Small rural hospitals with 25 inpatient beds at most, paid by Medicare on their costs.
Every one of its hospitals' latest Medicare cost report, added up.
Biggest by beds on its cost report. The answer names the hospital.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payrolls only: clinics, offices and any health plan are left out.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Faith Regional Health Services have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: No other Faith Regional Health Services hospital reports more; Genoa Community Hospital is next at 105. About 6.8 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Genoa Community Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Faith Regional Health Services hospitals; Faith Regional Health Services has the most, 833. About 5.5 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did West Holt Memorial Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 Faith Regional Health Services hospitals; Faith Regional Health Services has the most, 833. About 5.4 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees do Faith Regional Health Services's hospitals have on payroll, added together?
questions.why: From all 4 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2025.

questions.q: What percent of Faith Regional Health Services's inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: Traditional Medicare was 29 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 19 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Faith Regional Health Services's inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: Traditional Medicaid was 16 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 0 percent.

questions.q: Across all of Faith Regional Health Services's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 44 percent.

questions.q: Across all of Faith Regional Health Services's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 24 percent.

questions.q: How many beds did Faith Regional Health Services report to Medicare for 2024?
questions.why: No other Faith Regional Health Services hospital reports more; Genoa Community Hospital is next at 19 beds.

questions.q: How many beds did Niobrara Valley Hospital report to Medicare for fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That ranks third of 4 Faith Regional Health Services hospitals; Faith Regional Health Services has the most, 122 beds.

questions.q: How many beds did Genoa Community Hospital report to Medicare for fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That ranks second of 4 Faith Regional Health Services hospitals; Faith Regional Health Services has the most, 122 beds.

questions.q: How many beds did West Holt Memorial Hospital report to Medicare for fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 4 Faith Regional Health Services hospitals; Faith Regional Health Services has the most, 122 beds.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds did Faith Regional Health Services report to Medicare for 2024?
questions.why: That is 20 percent of its 122 beds.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Faith Regional Health Services report for 2024?
questions.why: About 13 a day.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did West Holt Memorial Hospital report for fiscal 2025?
questions.why: About 0 a day.

questions.q: How many days did the average inpatient stay last at Faith Regional Health Services in 2024?
questions.why: Across the cost reports of U.S. general hospitals it averages 5.0 days.

questions.q: On an average day in 2024, what percent of Faith Regional Health Services's beds had a patient in them?
questions.why: Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.

questions.q: How many hospitals does Faith Regional Health Services run, by the federal list of health systems?
questions.why: All of them are in Nebraska. A system's own count can differ: it may count campuses on their own, or hospitals that joined after 2023.

questions.q: How many of Faith Regional Health Services's hospitals are critical access hospitals?
questions.why: They are Genoa Community Hospital, Niobrara Valley Hospital and West Holt Memorial Hospital.

questions.q: How many beds do Faith Regional Health Services's hospitals report to Medicare, added together?
questions.why: From all 4 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2025.

questions.q: How many beds does Faith Regional Health Services's biggest hospital report to Medicare?
questions.why: It is Faith Regional Health Services. Genoa Community Hospital is next, with 19.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds do Faith Regional Health Services's hospitals report to Medicare, added together?
questions.why: That is 14 percent of their 171 beds. From all 4 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2025.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Faith Regional Health Services's hospitals report in a year, added together?
questions.why: About 14 a day. From all 4 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2025.
